subject: Temporary headroom & amortized true-up offer for BrightRetail launch
messages:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightretail.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Hi Marissa,

We have a campaign launching next Tuesday that will spike our inference demand substantially for about 72 hours. Forecast attached (BRIGHT-launch-traffic-forecast.xlsx).

Can Redwood provide: 2x our committed quota for a 72-hour window starting 2026-08-17? We need clarity on how you'd bill overruns and whether there’s a short-term discount/credit you can offer — procurement will push back on full paygo rates if it’s expensive.

Also, can you turn this around fast? We need a path that gets procurement comfortable without re-negotiating the whole contract.

Best,
Kate
Head of AI, BrightRetail

--- Message 2 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Kate — thanks for the heads up and the forecast. We can support a temporary headroom for the window you described. Two practical paths we see: 

1) Emergency pay-as-you-go headroom (fastest): we lift your quota for 72 hours to 2x committed capacity. Overrun billed at our standard overrun rate.

2) Provisional headroom with amortized true-up (recommended for predictable billing): we provision the extra capacity immediately, invoice the incremental usage on your normal cadence but amortize the overrun across the next 3 billing cycles at a blended rate. To make this simpler for procurement we can commit to a one-time discount on the amortized overrun volume.

Concretely — attached is a draft terms packet (Redwood-ephemeral-burst-terms-v1.pdf) showing the amortization math + sample invoice lines. Ben, can you confirm the blended rate and a discount we can offer here?

If procurement needs a short contract amendment we can route a one-page DocuSign for the provisional headroom. That will get them the legal language without a full SOW.

Next steps: confirm which path you prefer and we’ll prepare the amendment / amend invoice schedule.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182

--- Message 3 ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Adding the numbers so procurement gets a quick view.

Option A (Paygo headroom):
- Overrun rate: $0.0075 per token (standard overrun)
- No amortization or discount

Option B (Amortized true-up over 3 invoices):
- We’ll calculate the incremental charge for the 72-hour window and split it equally across next 3 invoices.
- Blended amortized rate example (based on expected volume in spreadsheet): ~$0.0058 per token (effective)
- One-time concession: 10% discount on the amortized overrun total if BrightRetail signs the one-page amendment within 48 hours of acceptance.
- We’ll cap exposure to a maximum dollar ceiling (suggest $18,000 for this event) so procurement has an upper bound.

Note: the cap is optional but tends to move deals faster.

If you want, I can draft the invoice lines and the short amendment language for Lauren to review.

— Ben
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

--- Message 4 ---
From: Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Thanks both — option B is preferable (amortized true-up) because procurement needs predictable line items. The forecast in the spreadsheet is our best snapshot: peak is expected 36–48 hours into the window and should tail off by hour 72.

A few asks from procurement: 
- Please confirm the amortization will appear as three equal incremental lines on the invoices.
- Confirm the 10% concession (Ben) and the suggested $18,000 cap. If you can put the cap in the amendment language it’ll help with procurement signoff.
- DocuSign link preferred for quick approval; procurement will process the one-page amendment and returns signed by EOD Friday if the draft matches the terms.

Can we get a draft amendment + sample invoice line items today?

Thanks,
Kate

--- Message 5 ---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Kate — looping in Finance/legal language. Draft amendment attached (Redwood-ephemeral-burst-terms-v1.pdf). Key points included:
- Three-equal-amortization lines on invoices following the month-end in which the overrun occurred.
- One-time 10% concession applied to the amortized overrun subtotal if amendment signed within 48 hours of proposal.
- Hard cap on liability for this event: $18,000 (we can set a lower cap if you need).
- Standard invoicing and net-30 payment terms apply; invoices will reference the original order id (BRIGHT-PLG-2026-09) for reconciliation.

Quote language I recommend for the amendment: 
"Redwood will provision temporary capacity for the period 2026-08-17 00:00 UTC through 2026-08-20 23:59 UTC. Incremental usage attributable to the temporary capacity will be invoiced and amortized over the following three billing cycles with a one-time concession of 10% applied to the amortized overrun subtotal. Redwood's aggregate liability for charges associated with this temporary provisioning event shall not exceed $18,000."

I’ve also included a sample invoice stub in the PDF and a CSV with the sample amortization schedule (usage-breakdown.csv). If that language works, Ben can publish the DocuSign draft and Marissa can shepherd for signature.

— Lauren
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

--- Message 6 ---
From: Kate Lin <kate@brightretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightRetail Procurement <procurement@brightretail.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightretail.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: launch week capacity bump

Marissa / Lauren / Ben — this looks good and should be acceptable to procurement. We confirm:
- We will take Option B (amortized true-up over 3 invoices)
- We accept the 10% one-time concession on the amortized overrun total if we sign within 48 hours.
- $18,000 cap acceptable.

Procurement will execute the one-page amendment via DocuSign once you publish it. Please send the DocuSign link and final invoice stubs so we can route internally.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Kate
Head of AI, BrightRetail
